summary: DC statehood advocates are pointing to recent federal interventions in local affairs—including a federal takeover, a dispute over voter rolls, and a court case involving ballroom construction—as evidence that the city lacks sufficient autonomy to govern itself. The headlines reflect ongoing tensions between DC's local authority and federal oversight, with supporters arguing these situations underscore the need for statehood.

articles.title: One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
D.C. Wins Fight Against Trump Administration Over Voter Rolls
Trump Must Stop Ballroom Construction, Appeals Court Rules
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
